item.title: Keep patched: JFrog Artifactory: Improper Authentication
item.description:
JFrog Artifactory: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 7.111.21, 7.117.28, 7.125.20

First step: Update JFrog Artifactory to the fixed version for your release line (for example 7.111.21, 7.117.28 or 7.125.20).

JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-82329
